rounds.msg: I will pay you ₹2,000 for the phone. Enter your UPI PIN on the request I sent so the money comes to you.
opts: Enter the PIN so the money arrives
Share the OTP you receive
Refuse, and check your own bank app for any credit
rounds.why: A PIN is only for sending money. If you must enter one, money leaves your account.

rounds.msg: You scan the QR printed on the shop counter. The app shows the shop's name and you enter your PIN to pay ₹180 for groceries.
opts: No, never enter a PIN anywhere
Yes, you started the payment and the name matches the shop
No, shops must never use QR codes
rounds.why: You chose to pay a known merchant and checked the name. Entering a PIN to pay is normal.

rounds.msg: I am from your bank. Your KYC expires in 1 hour and your account will be blocked. Tell me the OTP that just came.
opts: Read out the OTP quickly
Hang up and call the number printed on your card
Ask the caller for their employee ID and then share
rounds.why: Banks never ask for OTPs. Urgency is the trick. Always call back on an official number.

rounds.msg: A parcel in your name has drugs. You are under digital arrest. Stay on this call and do not tell your family. Pay ₹40,000 to clear the case.
opts: Stay on the call and pay to avoid arrest
Disconnect, tell your family and call 1930 if unsure
Negotiate a lower amount
rounds.why: There is no digital arrest. Police never arrest on video call or ask for money to close a case.

rounds.msg: You open your bank's official app yourself and see a button to update KYC. It asks you to upload your ID inside the app.
opts: Probably yes: you opened the official app yourself
No, KYC can never be done in an app
No, you must do it at a cyber cafe
rounds.why: You went to the official app on your own. Nobody pushed you or asked for an OTP over a call.

rounds.msg: Your refund is stuck. Please install AnyDesk and read me the 9-digit code so I can fix it from my side.
opts: Install it, since support needs to see the problem
Refuse and end the call
Install it but do not open your bank app
rounds.why: Remote apps let a stranger control your phone and see your OTPs, even if you do not open your bank app.

rounds.msg: Hi, this is my new number. I lost my phone and I am in a hospital. Please send ₹8,000 urgently. Don't call.
opts: Send a smaller amount to be safe
Call the person on their old saved number
Ask for a selfie and then pay
rounds.why: Photos can be copied. Only a call to their old number, or someone who is with them, can confirm.

rounds.msg: You earned ₹300 for liking videos. To unlock your ₹4,000 withdrawal, deposit ₹2,000 as a task fee.
opts: Deposit once, because you have already earned money
Stop. Pay nothing and report the group
Ask friends to join to share the fee
rounds.why: The small first payment builds trust. The deposits then grow and the money can never be withdrawn.

rounds.msg: Your electricity will be cut tonight. Call officer Rao on 98XXXXXXXX and install the app to pay ₹10.
opts: Call and install the app to avoid disconnection
Check the bill in the official electricity board app or website
Forward it to 10 friends
rounds.why: Boards do not disconnect over random SMS. The 'officer' wants control of your phone or payments.

rounds.from: Friend next to you · In person
rounds.msg: Your friend asks you to send ₹200 to his UPI ID for snacks. You can see him and the name on screen matches.
opts: Yes, you know him and checked the name
No, never pay a friend by UPI
No, ask for his PIN first
rounds.why: You know the person, can see them, and the payment is small and expected.
